title: Indian Independence
summary: India became independent from British rule on 15 August 1947 after a long freedom struggle involving leaders like Mahatma Gandhi, Jawaharlal Nehru, Subhas Chandra Bose and many others. The Constitution took effect on 26 January 1950 (Republic Day).
